dates.name: Alabama Shakes with Billy Allen & The Pollies — Red Butte Garden
dates.desc: Indie rock excellence! Alabama Shakes deliver powerful, soulful performances with incredible vocals and tight musicianship. Perfect summer outdoor concert in the stunning Red Butte Garden natural amphitheater with beautiful mountain sunset views.

dates.name: Lyle Lovett — Deer Valley Music Festival
dates.desc: Legendary singer-songwriter Lyle Lovett brings his distinctive country-rock artistry to the scenic Deer Valley outdoor amphitheater. Known for witty lyrics, masterful musicianship, and engaging live performances. Perfect romantic evening in the mountains.
dates.where: Snow Park Outdoor Amphitheater — Park City, UT (30 min from SLC)

dates.name: Chris Botti — GRAMMY-Winning Trumpeter with Utah Symphony
dates.desc: Smooth jazz and classical excellence! Grammy Award-winning trumpeter Chris Botti blends jazz, pop, and classical with expressive playing. He's performed with Sting, Barbra Streisand, and Tony Bennett. Romantic mountain setting, world-class musicianship.
dates.where: Snow Park Outdoor Amphitheater — Park City, UT (30 min from SLC)

dates.name: Outdoor Movie Night — 'Minecraft Movie' at Ashton Gardens
dates.desc: Bring a blanket and enjoy a movie under the stars in stunning Ashton Gardens! 40-foot outdoor screen, concession stand with popcorn and snacks, beautiful garden setting with mountain views. Perfect for a fun, casual summer date.
dates.where: Ashton Gardens at Thanksgiving Point — Lehi, UT (25 min south)

dates.name: MUNA — Twilight Concert Series
dates.desc: Indie pop trio MUNA brings energetic, feel-good music perfect for summer outdoor concerts. Fun, lively, and engaging performance. Free outdoor concert atmosphere—bring a blanket, relax, and enjoy great music.
dates.where: Gallivan Center or Civic Center — Salt Lake City, UT

dates.name: The Musical 'Chicago' — Utah Symphony with Broadway Vocalists
dates.desc: Classic Broadway musical performed by Utah Symphony with professional Broadway vocalists! Razzle-dazzle jazz, iconic songs, energetic choreography. Outdoor mountain amphitheater setting adds special magic. You loved Phantom—Chicago is equally stunning.
dates.where: Snow Park Outdoor Amphitheater — Park City, UT (30 min from SLC)

dates.name: Idina Menzel — 'Let It Go' and Broadway Hits with Utah Symphony
dates.desc: Tony Award-winning vocalist Idina Menzel performs Broadway's greatest hits with the Utah Symphony! Known for powerful vocals and iconic Disney/Broadway roles. Incredible mountain sunset backdrop, world-class performance, unforgettable evening.
dates.where: Snow Park Outdoor Amphitheater — Park City, UT (30 min from SLC)

dates.name: Rockport or Strawberry Reservoir — Summer Alpine Lake Adventure
dates.desc: August is perfect for alpine lake dates! Crystal-clear waters, warm sunny days, and mountain views. Choose between Rockport Reservoir (1 hr north) or Strawberry Reservoir for kayaking, paddleboarding, fishing, or shoreline picnicking. Your favorite type of exploration date.
dates.where: Rockport State Park (Coalville, UT) or Strawberry Reservoir (Wasatch National Forest, UT)

dates.name: Park City Mountain Biking or Hiking — 400+ Mile Trail Network
dates.desc: Park City has 400+ miles of scenic mountain trails! Perfect August weather for exploring. Choose easy to challenging hikes or bike rides with wildflower meadows and stunning mountain scenery. Various difficulty levels for all abilities.
dates.where: Park City Mountain Resort & Trail Network — Park City, UT (30 min from SLC)

dates.name: Stewart Falls Trail — Sundance Mountain Waterfall Hike
dates.desc: Moderate 3.5-mile hike through shaded aspen forest to a stunning two-tiered waterfall. Cool mountain air, picturesque alpine setting, and refreshing water. Perfect romantic hiking date.
dates.where: Sundance Resort — 8841 Alpine Loop Rd, Sundance, UT 84604 (45 min south)

dates.name: Antelope Island State Park — Scenic Loop & Wildlife Viewing
dates.desc: Drive or hike the 7-mile scenic loop spotting bison herds, pronghorn, and bighorn sheep. Perfect for wildlife photography and exploration. Clear August skies offer stunning Great Salt Lake sunset views.
dates.where: Antelope Island State Park — 4528 W 1700 S, Syracuse, UT 84075 (45 min north)

dates.name: Snowbird Alpine Tram — Hidden Peak Mountain Adventure
dates.desc: Ride the 2,000-foot aerial tram to Hidden Peak (11,000 ft) for breathtaking 360° views of the Wasatch Mountains. Cool alpine air, stunning vistas, and optional summit restaurant dining.
dates.where: Snowbird Resort — Little Cottonwood Canyon, UT (45 min east)

dates.name: Dinner at Handle — Park City Seasonal Chef's Menu
dates.desc: Intimate, chef-driven restaurant featuring Dave Jones' celebrated seasonal small plates. Fresh fish, heritage meats, creative vegetables. Excellent wine list and romantic outdoor patio option.
dates.where: Handle — 412 Main St, Park City, UT 84060 (30 min from SLC)

dates.name: Dinner at Log Haven — Millcreek Canyon Fine Dining
dates.desc: Scenic mountain setting four miles up Millcreek Canyon. Chef Dave Jones' sophisticated seasonal menu, beautiful views, and excellent service. Perfect romantic summer escape.
dates.where: Log Haven — 6451 Mill Canyon Rd, Salt Lake City, UT 84121 (15 min south)

dates.name: Dinner at The Tree Room — Sundance Mountain Fine Dining
dates.desc: Tucked into the mountains at Sundance with cool alpine breezes. Seasonal American cuisine, mountain views, rustic elegance, exceptional service.
dates.where: The Tree Room — Sundance Resort, 8841 Alpine Loop Rd, Sundance, UT 84604

dates.name: Horseback Ride & Cowboy Dinner — Sundance Alpine Experience
